meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude会进入“对抗式规划”:召集5位性格各异的AI成员,让它们互相攻击彼此的方案观点,只保留经得住反驳的见解,再强制交给专门的规划代理整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”等触发词,或要求进行对抗式、严格批判式的规划时触发。

say.text: 用hyperplan批判一下我的产品发布计划。
say.note: Claude会宣布模式开启,召集5名成员互相挑刺。

say.text: hyperplan:对这份迁移方案做对抗性评审,找出漏洞。
say.note: 各角色会逐一攻击方案里的薄弱假设与漏洞。

say.text: 用hyperplan规划新功能,重点暴露我没想到的盲区。
say.note: 辩论后只保留经得住质疑的观点,再交规划代理。

howto.what_en: Claude enters adversarial-planning mode: it summons 5 hostile AI critics, keeps only insights that survive their cross-attacks, then hands them to a dedicated planner for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', or ask for adversarial/cross-critique planning.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to critique my product launch plan.
say_en.note: Claude announces mode and starts the debate.

say_en.text: hyperplan: adversarially review this migration plan for holes.
say_en.note: All 5 critics attack weak assumptions and gaps.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan a feature and surface my blind spots.
say_en.note: Surviving insights go to the planner.
